name: @qu/space-transport
description: Qu V5: transport + relay for @qu/space-core. InProcessTransport/InProcessHub simulate client<->relay<->client delivery for tests without a real network; WsClientTransport/createWsServerHub are the real-network counterpart (see relay-server.js, runnable directly or via the repo's packages/space-transport/Dockerfile). RelayForwarder verifies each envelope's write signature, forwards it live, and - given a storage adapter - mirrors it, so a peer that connects after the original author went offline still catches up (see relay.js). It never holds a decryption key, so it structurally cannot read content. PresenceTracker + an optional @qu/events bus let it also route (never decide) push-vs-online notifications off a write's own unencrypted notify hint - see push-handler.js for the pluggable delivery decision.
